analysis.purpose: Test helper that extracts the number of indexed files from a `crib index` CLI run's stdout, so cli.test.ts assertions can check the reported file count without parsing the whole log line by hand.
responsibilities: Return the captured count as a number, or -1 as a sentinel when the pattern is absent

businessRules.rule: Returns -1 when stdout doesn't contain an 'indexed N files' line

invariants: Return value is either a non-negative integer parsed from stdout, or the sentinel -1
preconditions: stdout is the full captured output of a CLI invocation
outputs: number — parsed file count, or -1 if no match
errorBehavior: Never throws; absence of a match degrades to -1 instead of throwing
risks: Silently returns -1 if the 'indexed N files' log line's wording ever changes, which could mask a real regression rather than failing loudly
whatToDistrust: 2 call sites (match, Number) show as unresolved in coverage — these are JS built-ins, not an indexing gap

nodes.name: CLI index-count extraction
nodes.summary: Regex-based parse of the CLI's 'indexed N files' stdout line into an integer count for test assertions.
